title: Automate the data refresh from official NBA sources
detail: A script re-pulls the games page and injury PDF each run, and writes a timestamp and checksum per file.
benefit: Repeatable, auditable data; removes manual copy errors.
risk: Scraping may break when pages change. Needs monitoring.

title: Parse the injury PDF with a table-aware tool and cross-check
detail: Use a PDF table extractor, then compare each row with the text extraction. Mismatches go to Flagged for Review. Session W evidence (2026-11-14): both the 05:15 PM and 08:00 PM ET editions lose leading cells at page breaks — 20 + 11 rows respectively currently show no printed team. A per-row carry-provenance rule (only from an earlier edition that printed the row) is already implemented in data/raw/injury_report_2026-11-13_08_00PM.json and is the minimum a parser must preserve; anything else is inference.
benefit: Fixes F-02 to F-07 at the source and closes flags W-F4/W-F7 (see review.html) without inferring team cells.

title: Add a legal review gate before any betting-related output
detail: Nothing that looks like a wager, line, or prize leaderboard is published until a qualified Dutch legal review (Q-04) is done.

title: Source historical game logs and minutes from official NBA stats
detail: Collect per-game box scores and minutes for the past seasons to support correlation and backtest work (Q-06, Q-08).
benefit: Enables validation; without it no strategy can pass gates.
risk: Volume and rate limits; must verify each row.

title: Pick an odds source with clear license terms before modelling prices
detail: Identify a licensed odds provider or an open dataset with explicit reuse rights (Q-07). Record the terms on the Sources page.
benefit: Makes the originated-lines comparison and CLV measurable.

title: Add per-row 'as of' timestamps to every table
detail: Show when each row was retrieved, so records and injury statuses can be read in context (F-08).

title: Add filter, search, and CSV export on each table
detail: Let users filter by date, team, or status, and download the table.

title: Add a Dutch / English language switch
detail: The user is in the Netherlands; a language toggle would help non-English reviewers.

title: Track suggestions and decisions in GitHub Issues
detail: Use an issue template per suggestion with a 'decision' label, instead of editing this static page.
benefit: Clear audit trail of what was chosen and why.

title: Add responsible-gambling information if any betting content is shown
detail: Ksa runs responsible-gambling campaigns (Gokstop). Add links only after the exact official URLs are verified.
benefit: Safer presentation of any betting-related content.

title: Consolidate the two landing pages into one
detail: Two sites now exist: the root 'NBA Edge Lab' dashboard (from another session, PRs #1 and #2) and this session's multi-page site in docs/. Pick one landing page and link the other as a subpage. Nothing was changed on the root site.
benefit: One clear entry point; one navigation structure.
risk: Touches another session's files, so it needs your decision and that session's agreement.
